name: tool-outcomes
why: The bytes a tool result really carries under the harness: `ToolResult::render`'s NO_RESULT envelope, mark and all, sitting inside <tool_response>. The renderer emits it verbatim — the envelope is the tool runtime's and adding a second one there wraps the result twice — so what this checks is that a payload full of angle brackets and the literal `</tool_call>` stays DATA and never becomes a boundary.

items.name: grep
items.payload:
<<<NO_RESULT 5ebfdef6>>>
tool: grep
reason: no match under any relaxation
